info.name: QAssure AI Gateway — Embedding Config Update
info.description: Updated Postman collection with custom embedding model support. Branch: yasha_24thapril. Includes all 42+ AI endpoints with embedding config changes highlighted.

request.description: Get access_token. Auto-saves to collection variable.

custom_embedding_models and default_embedding_model are the new fields.

These are auto-resolved from tenant's configured embedding provider.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "doc_analyzer_v1",
  "description": "Analyze documents",
  "use_case": "document_analysis",
  "system_message": "You are an expert document analyst.",
  "user_template": "Analyze this document:\n\n{{user_instructions}}\n\n{{file_content}}",
  "model": "gemini-2.0-flash",
  "provider": "gemini",
  "temperature": 0.3,
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "variables": [
    {
      "name": "user_instructions",
      "type": "string",
      "required": false,
      "default": ""
    },
    {
      "name": "file_content",
      "type": "string",
      "required": false,
      "default": "See attached file."
    }
  ],
  "tags": [
    "multimodal",
    "document"
  ],
  "is_default": true
}
